hooks.command: echo 'CONTEXT WAS COMPACTED. The harness skills are no longer in context. Before doing anything else, re-read in this order: ~/.claude/skills/orchestrator-harness/SKILL.md, references/modes.md, references/usage.md, references/routing.md, references/thinking.md, references/verification.md, then .harness/config.md (the mode), .harness/spec.md (the frozen Goal) and the current RUN-STATUS.md under .harness/runs/. Resume from the recorded state, not from memory of it.'

echo 'SESSION RESUMED. Re-read ~/.claude/skills/orchestrator-harness/SKILL.md, .harness/config.md and .harness/spec.md before continuing; check that no host you need is actually exhausted before dispatching (quota never chooses the model); resume from RUN-STATUS.md under .harness/runs/, not from memory.'
